Agnico Eagle Mines LTD (AEM) Holding Has Upped by Addenda Capital Inc; As Albemarle (ALB) Stock Declined, Shareholder Bbr Partners Cut Its Holding by $836,549
May 14, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Addenda Capital Inc increased its stake in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd (AEM) by 20.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Addenda Capital Inc bought 103,380 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.52% with the market. The institutional investor held 598,617 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.73 million, up from 495,237 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Addenda Capital Inc who had been investing in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $44.73. About 1.21M shares traded. Agnico Eagle Mines Limited (NYSE:AEM) has declined 6.12% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.67% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc decreased its stake in Albemarle Corp (ALB) by 40.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bbr Partners Llc sold 6,587 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,731 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.24M, down from 16,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Albemarle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.91 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.15% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $98.54. About 1.68M shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 10.68% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.23% the S&P500.
